search_text: published ZDI-16-588 ZDI-CAN-3730 Hewlett Packard Enterprise System Management Homepage SSO TKN Stack Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2016-11-02 CVE-2016-4396 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2016-4396 10.0 ['Hewlett Packard Enterprise'] ['System Management Homepage'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise System Management Homepage. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of /proxy/sso requests. When parsing the TKN parameter, the process copies user-supplied data into a fixed-length stack buffer. A remote attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute remote code under the context of the process. Hewlett Packard Enterprise has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
